description:
## Assigned scope
Own hardware/backend/capability modules, node build profiles, effective container limits, unified/dedicated memory, probe computation, explicit overrides and unavailable/unknown states.

Full contracts, architecture, persistence, privacy, platform candidates, and Action reuse evidence are embedded in parent zaq-za4. This issue owns only the assigned subset of work package S2; sibling issues own the rest.

### S2 — Serving role and real capability discovery

- **Files/specification:** role/application/router maps; `serving/{supervisor,api,capabilities,backend}.ex`, `serving/hardware/*`; existing deployment files discovered before editing. Lightweight boot, profile-specific native dependencies, explicit capability DTO and backend selection.
- **Tests first:** role parsing/default `:all`/startup; capability parser fixtures; missing libraries/drivers; stale/unknown values; OS versus container limits; unified-memory accounting; selection override and CPU fallback.
- **Paths validated:** BO/Engine-only startup, serving-only startup, mixed roles; no enabled models means no download/allocation; failed accelerator probes produce actionable capabilities.
- **Mocks:** no internal blanket mocks; pure fixture parsing and controlled production probe boundaries, plus real hardware smoke tests.
- **Docs:** `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/services/serving.md`, `docs/dev-setup.md`.
- **Reuse:** extend canonical role/router infrastructure; probes remain local-only.



## Execution requirements
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service/design guides. Tests first as specified above; only feature E2E awaits final human UX approval. Read edited module docs; use Zaq.Config and existing actor/event/startup seams. No routine application-env mutation or blanket internal mocks. Preserve NodeRouter/credential/privacy boundaries. No task is implemented at creation.

## Prerequisites
zaq-za4.6
zaq-za4.1

comments.text: Action reuse assessment (partial implementation): searched lib/zaq/agent/tools and lib/zaq/actions for hardware/backend/probe/memory/capability; only generic model-tool capability registry, no hardware operation. Decision: local-only Zaq.Serving.Hardware.probe/1, Backend.select/2, Hardware.RuntimeProbe.run/1 and Memory pure parsers. Node-local measurements and native subprocess probes are startup/serving-domain infrastructure, not composable agent Actions; automatic agent-tool exposure would cross ownership/privacy boundaries. Contract: read-only node-local snapshot with expiry, unknown measurements nil, native tiny tensor check isolated in bounded child; explicit override fails closed; no actor or user side effects, retries require fresh probe. Consumers: future Serving lifecycle/Engine event API, not Agent/workflow. Verification: pure fixture/property tests and macOS native smoke; Linux build/hardware verification pending.

Progress (uncommitted): added local capability DTO, Linux cgroup/meminfo parsing and effective memory, explicit fail-closed backend selection and node-local override, and isolated native EMLX/EXLA tiny-tensor probes (8s timeout; does not start models). Mac arm64 smoke: EMLX GPU and CPU probes succeeded, selected emlx_gpu; unknown free memory remains nil. Serving-only focused suite passes 1 property + 13 tests, mix q passes. Issue remains in_progress: no cross-role reporting or Engine coordination yet (later siblings), Linux EXLA CUDA/CPU and cgroup v1/v2 real host smoke not available here, test DB in this worktree unprepared so full default-role tests cannot run. No commit/push/merge. Action reuse: local-only hardware infrastructure, not agent Action (prior comment).
